en-US.name: Nodus Link: Research and Study
en-US.subtitle: Your research, on the go
en-US.promotionalText: Take the ideas, argument maps, reports, dictionary and podcasts of your Nodus Research workspace with you, straight from your own computer and without the cloud.
en-US.whatsNew: First release of Nodus Link: consult your Nodus Research workspace from iPhone and iPad.
en-US.description:
Nodus Link lets you consult, on your iPhone or iPad, the research you keep in Nodus Research for desktop.

BEFORE YOU START
First download and install Nodus Research on a Windows, macOS or Linux computer from https://nodusresearch.com. You need a version that includes the mobile connection. Nodus Link needs that application to reach your workspace.

HOW TO CONNECT YOUR DEVICES
1. Open Nodus Research on the computer and go to Settings > Mobile connection.
2. Open Nodus Link on the iPhone or iPad.
3. Scan the QR code, open the pairing link or enter the code the computer shows.

Pairing links your workspace. To see up-to-date content, the computer must be on, Nodus Research open, and both devices able to reach each other on the same local network or through a VPN such as Tailscale. If the connection drops, Nodus Link tries to restore it when the computer is available again, without asking for another code.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Consult your ideas and the sources that support them.
• Explore the graph of ideas and their relationships.
• Browse argument maps and open each idea.
• Read the Deep Research reports saved on your computer, or open them in Nodus Reader.
• Look up concepts in the dictionary with their definitions, versions, evidence and relations.
• Listen to the podcasts created in Nodus Research, with transcripts, sources, chapters and fine speed control.

TRY IT WITHOUT A COMPUTER
Open the example vault from the first screen to explore a small public-domain corpus that ships with the app. No account and no connection needed.

This first version focuses on consultation. Creating, editing and generating content happen in Nodus Research for desktop. Pairing your devices does not publish your research on the internet.

whatToTest.es-ES:
Novedades de esta build:
• Nueva barra inferior nativa con efecto Liquid Glass y reproductor integrado al estilo de Nodus Reader.
• Etiquetas más cortas en la barra y nueva hoja de secciones en «Más».
• Diccionario: acciones como iconos, filtros en un globo e índice alfabético lateral.
• Deep Research: botón PDF que abre directamente la hoja de compartir y nuevo botón «Nodus Reader».
• Control de velocidad de los podcasts de 0,75× a 2× en pasos de 0,05×.
• Iconos de los menús legibles en modo oscuro y etiquetas de búsqueda traducidas.

Qué probar: navegación por la barra inferior y «Más», reproducción y velocidad de un podcast, exportar un informe a PDF y abrirlo en Nodus Reader.

reviewNotes:
Nodus Link 0.1.0 beta review notes

No account or demo account is needed. Nodus Link is a read-only companion that connects directly to the Nodus Research desktop application on the user's own computer (local network or the user's VPN); there is no Nodus server.

To review without a computer: on the first screen tap "See an example vault" ("Ver un vault de ejemplo"). It opens a small public-domain corpus bundled in the app and works offline: ideas and their sources, the graph, the argument map, the dictionary and search. Deep Research reports and podcasts are created in the desktop app, so they appear only once a computer is paired.

Permissions: the camera is used only to scan the pairing QR code shown by the desktop app; local network access reaches the paired computer; Face ID is an optional app lock. The app has no analytics, advertising or tracking SDK and sends no content to third parties. "Nodus Reader" on a report opens the iOS Open In menu for Nodus Reader when installed, or its public TestFlight page otherwise.

This delivery is TestFlight only. No production App Store review is requested.
